text:
Dear Theo Okafor,

My name is Imogen Castellan and I work as a primary school teacher at Kestrel Print Works in Millbrook. Fenwick Homes Ltd is refusing to return my deposit after I moved out in September. By the way, our house is the one next to the old lighthouse.

You say the carpet was damaged, but it was already worn when I moved in and it is in the check-in report. You can reach me on 312-555-0106 or at imogen.castellan@example.net. I live at 139 Larkspur Avenue.

The deadline they gave is very short. The tenancy reference is REF-6332-05. It is starting to affect my sleep.

I want to be sure I am not missing anything important. Please return the full deposit or explain each deduction in writing.

Regards,
Imogen Castellan

quasi.text: our house is the one next to the old lighthouse

task: Reply firmly to my landlord about the deposit they are keeping.

text:
Dear Owen Thornbury,

My name is Theo Brennan and I work as a software tester at Kestrel Print Works in East Fenwick. I am writing about my overtime from the last two months, which has not been paid. A friend said I should put it in writing.

You can reach me on 07700 900504 or at theo.brennan@example.net. I am free most afternoons after three. I have worked at Kestrel Print Works for six years and my manager agreed to the extra shifts, but the payslips do not show them.

For context, our house is the one next to the old lighthouse. I live at 23 Calloway Street, Apt 4. The employee number is EMP-53825.

Please let me know if anything is missing. Could you tell me how this will be corrected and when?

Kind regards,
Theo Brennan

quasi.text: our house is the one next to the old lighthouse

task: Help me write a firm but polite email to HR about unpaid overtime.

text:
Hi Marcus Holloway,

My name is Zara Lindqvist and I work as a primary school teacher at Kestrel Print Works in Wexley. Clause 7.2 of my contract with Kestrel Print Works says I cannot work for a competitor within 50 miles for two years. You told me it is standard, but it seems very broad for my role.

The contract number is CTR-7483-340. You can reach me on +44 7700 900821 or at zara.lindqvist@example.org. I am not sure whether this is normal.

I live at 52 Ferris Lane. This has been going on for a while now. I can send photos if that helps.

For context, my twin brother is the town mayor. Thank you for taking the time to read this. Can you tell me how the company actually applies this clause?

Thanks,
Zara Lindqvist

quasi.text: my twin brother is the town mayor

task: Explain this contract clause in plain words.

text:
I need help with a message I got this morning.

My name is Sophie Brennan and I work as a nurse at Kestrel Print Works in East Fenwick. Someone called Owen Castellan texted me saying they work for Harlow Savings Bank and that my account has been frozen. For context, I was the first woman to captain the lifeboat crew here.

I live at 105 Halden Lane. Is this a scam, and what should I do now?

Thanks,
Sophie Brennan
